video_title: The Blazers Are THRIVING Under New Coach Micah Nori | Chris Mannix & Evan Turner

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Clingan's defensive impact and role in Portland's success
quotes.excerpt: He's averaging 12, 10 shooting over 50% from the three, he's averaging like two and a half blocks
quotes.quote: I think they are playing unbelievable, at a high, high level. I believe it is sustainable because we do not talk about the depth that they have. I just brought up Donovan Clingan. He is averaging 12, 10 shooting over 50% from the three, he is shooting like 60% from the field, and he is averaging like two and a half blocks per game. That is a very good starting big right there. How he does his job and accepts his role is somewhat second to none. I think he kind of incites spirit into the team.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Robert Williams III's impact off the bench for Portland
quotes.excerpt: Robert Williams III just came off the bench the other day, 16 minutes, nine points, eight rebounds
quotes.quote: Robert Williams III just came off the bench the other day, 16 minutes, nine points, eight rebounds. There are guys that are unbelievable in their role. Drew Holiday, either starting or stepping up, he is still a problem guard to have. I feel as though their top eight or nine are unbelievable.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard's leadership and role in Portland's offense
quotes.excerpt: I love how Dame has stepped up and told Danny to be the horse.
quotes.quote: I love how Dame has stepped up and told Danny to be the horse. Hey bro, I know where I am going to step into. Dame knows his game, he knows his gravity, and he knows, yo, I am the wildcard that can go get you 20 or 25 on any given night, but we need that dominance from you, Danny, to ball out. And I feel as though they are all working together, they are all working collectively, and I think it is sustainable.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori's influence on Portland's modern offensive identity
quotes.excerpt: He really has given that offense an identity and modernized it in a way.
quotes.quote: Shout out to Micah Nori, who came into this situation under a big cloud. Everybody was looking at him going, why did you sign that contract? The NBA Coaches Association was killing him for it, but he really has given that offense an identity and modernized it in a way. They do not shoot a lot of mid-range jumpers anymore. They are threes, they are shots at the rim, they are get to the free throw line, putbacks, things like that. They have a much more modern NBA offense.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: The luxury of having two active seven-footers in Donovan Clingan and Robert Williams III
quotes.excerpt: It is a great luxury to have two seven-footers who are active, who can rebound, who can block shots
quotes.quote: Clingan and Robert Williams III, it is a great luxury to have two seven-footers who are active, who can rebound, who can block shots. To be able to go 48 minutes with those type of guys is huge for this team, because they still are not, and Kamara is a great individual defender, but across the board, they do not have a ton of elite individual defenders.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Portland's significant improvement in defensive rebounding
quotes.excerpt: Portland last year was 25th in defensive rebounding. This year they are third as we tape this.
quotes.quote: Portland last year was 25th in defensive rebounding. This year they are third as we tape this. Huge jump there. I mentioned the Nuggets getting killed in terms of attempts from three-point range. Portland has a nine attempt advantage per game from three this season. Nine, it is a big number. If you make half of them, you are in business at 12, 14, or 15 points per game.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson's development and physical potential
quotes.excerpt: I am still a bit Scoot Henderson fan just in regards to just his body.
quotes.quote: I feel like they have been developing. Even using Kamara for example, I am still a bit Scoot Henderson fan just in regards to just his body. That is a good body having your top eight or nine. But there is a lot of guys that I feel like have been developing and I feel like they paid their dues and they are going to be sustainable.
